subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option that can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. If you feel Options A, B, or C do not improve the sentence, then choose Option D: "No improvement required."

__The reason why I am confused is because__ they are giving me mixed signals.

options.text: Why am I confused is because
The reason for my confusion is because

solution:
The correct answer is '**3**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is about expressing confusion due to receiving mixed signals.
 
• The phrase "**I am confused because**" is concise and grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 1:** "Why am I confused is because" is awkward and ungrammatical.
